title: South Lenches Parish Council — use licensed waste carriers
body:
South Lenches Parish Council would like to remind Lenches residents of the importance of using licensed waste carriers for waste disposal services. Residents should always obtain receipts or waste transfer notes, report fly-tipping promptly and never allow waste collections from your home by unverified operators. To help tackle the issue of fly-tipping in our rural communities Wychavon has launched WasteGuard, a free online service allowing residents to locate licensed operators and reduce the risk of illegal disposal.

Clerk to South Lenches Parish Council, clerk@southlenchesparishcouncil.org
